profile.name: SCILA抽屉式培养存储装置
profile.description: 一种带抽屉访问的实验室环境控制装置，可用于样品或微孔板的培养或受控存储。该设备支持温度控制，并可查询液位、温度、CO₂流量、阀门以及抽屉状态。
profile.description_en: A drawer-based laboratory environmental control unit for incubating or storing samples or microplates under controlled conditions. It supports temperature control and can report liquid level, temperature, CO2 flow, valve status, and drawer status.
